remarks: Tucked in the rolling hills of  West Falls, NY,  this striking chalet-style home offers the perfect blend of modern cabin charm and open-concept living. Set on 11.8 acres of serene countryside, this is more than a home, it's a lifestyle. Located just 14 minutes from Kissing Bridge, 13 minutes from Highmark Stadium, and just 25 minutes from Downtown Buffalo, you won’t have to sacrifice convenience for true country living.  Step inside and feel the space open up around you. The open floor plan creates an airy, welcoming atmosphere with the warmth and character you'd expect from a mountain retreat. You’ll find plenty of  natural light, and a layout designed for both relaxed everyday living and effortless entertaining. The chalet-inspired architecture gives the property undeniable curb appeal and a one-of-a-kind presence that sets it apart from the ordinary. Walk in from the ground up with the spacious finished basement complete with full bar and plenty of storage. On the main floor, 20 foot ceilings and large windows in the great room provide plenty of natural light. The huge eat in kitchen leads out to a 3 season room complete with a wood burning hot tub. 3 bedrooms, a full bath, and first floor laundry round out the rest of the space, including  a massive wrap around deck! Upstairs, a loft with the primary bedroom and en-suite will make you feel like you are on vacation all year long. Outside, nearly 12 acres of land invite you to dream big. Whether you're envisioning trails through the woods, a hobby farm, an additional outbuilding, or simply the peace and privacy that only acreage can provide, the possibilities here are truly endless. Nature lovers, outdoor enthusiasts, and those seeking a true escape from the everyday will feel right at home. Perfect for a family compound, short term rental investor or a private family homestead!  This property is being offered together with parcel (Tax ID: 142489-199-000-0004-009-200) also known as 111 Behm rd which is a 2/1 double that sits on 6.5 acres with 290 frontage totaling 920 frontage by 1105 for a total of 18.30 acres combined with both properties. Seller is open to possible owner financing.
